fields.title: iPhone 13 Pro Max Blue
fields.description: Lost my iPhone 13 Pro Max in Sierra Blue color near the bus stop. Has a black leather case with a small scratch on the back. IMEI: 352099001761481. Screen lock is enabled.
fields.location_detail: Near the coffee shop on the left side of the bus stop

fields.title: Blue Smartphone Found
fields.description: Found a blue colored smartphone near MG Road. It has a black leather case. The phone is locked. Kept safely, please contact to claim with proof.
fields.location_detail: Found near the bus stop area

fields.title: Aadhaar Card & PAN Card
fields.description: Lost my Aadhaar Card and PAN Card in a brown leather wallet. The wallet also had a driving license and two debit cards. Lost near the railway station.
fields.location_detail: Platform 3 or the ticket counter area

fields.title: Brown Leather Wallet with Documents
fields.description: Found a brown leather wallet near the railway station. Contains some ID cards and bank cards. Please contact with details to claim.

fields.title: Honda Activa Keys
fields.description: Lost Honda Activa keys with a small keychain of Ganesha idol. The key has Honda logo engraved. Lost somewhere in the market area.

fields.title: Gold Chain Necklace
fields.description: Found a gold chain necklace with a small locket near the park. The locket has a photo inside. Please contact to claim with description.

fields.title: Dell Laptop Bag with Laptop
fields.description: Lost my Dell Inspiron 15 laptop in a black Dell laptop bag. The laptop has stickers on the back and a small crack on the bottom right corner. Has important project files.
fields.location_detail: Left in bus, last seen near Majestic Bus Stand

fields.title: Returned: PAN Card to Owner
fields.description: PAN Card was found and returned to the rightful owner after verification. Owner provided correct details and the card was handed over safely.
